basis: Visually reviewed finish over the colour-preserving shadow v3. Remove tiny unprotected components, actual-covered residual surfaces and exact duplicates; re-prune after filtering; join only guarded sub-1.8cm coplanar seams. Two photo-depth-verified main-stair side walls use their real photographed boundaries and remove cross-session occluders by seven-point hits on the actual replacement mesh, including wrong-normal facets only within those explicit bare-wall regions. Source map poses, fixed floors/cavity, original photos and existing signs remain. Existing colours are retained outside the two photo wall replacements. Nineteen fixed-camera renders and two tiny-motion sequences expose remaining stair noise, texture seams and unobserved edges. This is a finished working display derivative, not a claim that all defects or navigation safety are solved.

outside.reason: All existing outside geometry retained; no global flattening of real outdoor slopes or invented outdoor ceiling.

lobby.reason: Keep prior floor/sign/door coordinates and photos, accepted old soffit heights and lower atrium opening. Add underside/side skins only beneath actual upper-floor support, leaving independent ceiling/floor levels. Match new materials and three artificial grey fascia materials to local real ceiling/wall colour. Unknown material/shape is labelled inferred. Non-walkable display only.

floor2.reason: Keep v15 floor material, complete PRIME HALL and all existing floor/stair/door/glazing XYZ. Extend the upper ceiling at the existing height within the prior floor/roof envelope, replacing coplanar overlap only. Original ceiling colour/detail is sampled correctly; new unknown material is inferred. Do not treat the added ceiling as measured geometry or a navigable surface.

bridge_out1f.reason: The previously accepted balanced_only geometry is the source, not the rejected rebuilt trial. Only indoor-clipped horizontal ground is replaced; source standing structures and outside slope geometry retained.

bridge_12_sub.reason: Protected stairs/landings, all horizontal faces and v15 appearance retained. Only small unprotected convex contour teeth and narrow texture edge bands are softened. No stair flattening, new roof/floor or claim of visual approval at every location.
